title: Data Structures & Control Flow
description: Learn how to organize data using lists and dictionaries, and how to control your program's behavior using conditional logic.
learningObjectives: Manage collections of data with lists
Use dictionaries to store key-value pairs
Implement branching logic with if, elif, and else

sections.content: A list is an ordered collection of items. In Python, lists are created using square brackets [].

exercises.question: Create a list called `colors` with three strings: "red", "green", and "blue". Print the list.
